# HAPI v0.30.7.6

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Same official base as v0.30.7.5 (no new official main commits).
- New carries:
  - Claude: mid-turn Steer for remote Claude sessions (#2008), with a maintained fix for the three open review findings on that PR. Steers sent before Claude reports prompt lifecycle stay recoverable, a denied tool or plan exit stops the old Claude process before queued steers return to the queue, and a rejected cancel keeps the steer's transcript echo marker.
  - Claude: sessions waiting on background tasks show as working (#2102), Claude Code 2.x subagent transcripts in local mode (#2091), local-mode context window seeded from the configured model (#2088), API error records with null `service_tier` forwarded (#2087).
  - Codex: Web Rewind restored for shared sessions (#2092), with a maintained fix so a rewind the CLI cannot complete quarantines the session instead of leaving it stuck; legacy history no longer re-inserted on shared resume (#2099); inherited fork history included in transcript sync (#2096); "Approve for me" permission mode (#2090); slow Codex startups kept across runner deadlines (#2078).
  - CLI: `hapi set-mode <exact-session-id> <mode>` changes a session's permission mode (#2095). Like the other peer commands here, it takes the exact session ID, not a prefix.
  - Hub: liveness judged by hub receive time instead of the runner clock (#2089).
  - Web: rich composer undo history (#2097), one older page loaded when the cold tail is tool-only (#2098), pending requests on archived sessions ignored in the sidebar (#2101), transient scrollbar overflow contained during resize (#2077).
  - Sessions: read/unread state synced across devices (#2080), per-session title locks (#2072), and hub fallback titles after the first completed turn (#2075).
  - OpenCode: v2 supported alongside v1 sessions (#2042), and mid-turn Steer for remote OpenCode sessions (#1981).
  - Peer tools: hide `inspect_peer` / `ping_peer` / `spawn_peer` hub-wide from Settings → General for new sessions, or pin one runner with `HAPI_DISABLE_PEER_TOOLS` (#2052, #2056). On this fork the switch also covers `spawn_peer` and `hapi spawn-peer`.
  - Claude/Codex: Claude no longer limited to three hard-coded model aliases (#1948), Codex history actions wait for the native thread (#1604), agent titles replace Fork seed summaries (#1849), Luna Reserve offered as a manual Codex model (#1836).
  - CLI: buffered ACP assistant text flushed after an idle gap (#1898), DSH skills discovered from the DeepSeek Harness home (#1916), inline-media shell fallback reported as not applicable in packaged installs (#1920).
  - Hub: notify-cause ingest kept bounded (#1844), typed errors for undeliverable permission answers and aborts (#1921), ACP cost recorded with per-agent usage reporting (#1468).
  - Web: answerable card for permissions the tracer dropped (#1903), file preview fixes (#1718, #1726), machine health shown in single-machine layouts (#1664), loaded older history kept while a session streams (#1542), unified composer model and effort controls (#1662), project-group context menu (#1607), sessions draggable into composer mentions (#1418), assistant response navigation (#1597).
- Hub database upgrades from schema 27 to 29 and cannot be opened by an older hub afterwards; back up `hapi.db` before upgrading if you may roll back. The upgrade clears usage totals, which the hub rebuilds by rescanning messages.
- Refreshed #2061 to its latest head (archive dismissal and delete waiting states).
- #2035 stays at its v0.30.7.5 head. Its newer head conflicts with the carried #1940 and #2046 Windows process-probe changes, so the refresh is deferred.

## Compared with the official release

- Rebuilt from official main 5d8deb201189dc1f183c4f5bf38c87ec4d34dd70 (official release train v0.30.7), with audited open PR carries listed in the release record.
- Includes Claude mid-turn Steer, the maintained session-control workflow, voice draft delivery, notification, composer, session-list, file-search, Codex runner and DSH fixes.
- Retains signed macOS CLI artifacts, standalone Linux/Windows CLIs, desktop packages, four-part release gates and a replayable release manifest.
- Fork-only features removed in v0.30.7.3 remain omitted. Closed unmerged PR #847 remains absent; PR #1320 is never replayed as a carry.

Complete per-PR decisions and personal policy exceptions: tools/maintenance/releases/v0.30.7.6/.
